sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate is semantically faithful and deterministic validation is valid. It correctly targets ships, applies the requirement only to passenger ships, enforces sizeCompatibilityStatus=true, requires exactly one assignment per person, and constrains each assignment to one immersion suit or thermal protective aid. The non-passenger alternative correctly excludes passenger ships, and all used terms, datatypes, owners, paths, and namespaces are valid.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: The candidate does not enforce the requirement's singular assignment: each person can have multiple hasPersonalSurvivalEquipmentAssignment values, and each assignment can identify multiple assignedPersonalSurvivalEquipment values.
